import ssl

    HTTPSConnection('example.com', proxy_config=pc, ssl_context=ssl.create_default_context())
    print('NO ERROR - BUG')
except ValueError as e:
    print('OK:', e)

pc2 = ProxyConfig(None, True, None, None)
try:
    HTTPSConnection('example.com', proxy_config=pc2, ssl_context=ssl.create_default_context())
    print('NO ERROR - BUG')
except ValueError as e:
    print('OK:', e)

# forwarding without ssl_context should work fine
c = HTTPSConnection('example.com', proxy_config=pc)
print('OK no ssl_context works')
